verdict.rationale: Relay offers some bulk-style automation — auto-transferring funds across up to 20 accounts, issuing up to 50 cards, multi-step approval rules, and bulk vendor bill uploads — but these are manual UI-driven configurations rather than a programmatic/bulk-API interface an AI-native user could drive across many items at once. Missing for 10: evidence of an API or agent-facing bulk operation endpoint, batch transaction processing, or CSV/bulk import-export capability confirmed by independent testing.
